entities.name: Terrik
entities.description: An elven wurmcaller of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica, remorseful over an accident that killed two dozen people.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of harmony and community that Terrik belongs to.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane on which Terrik lives.

entities.name: Ambrellin
entities.description: A dryad and Terrik's friend and host.

entities.name: Bazda
entities.description: A young girl who lost her parents in the accident and lives in an orphanage Terrik secretly supports.

entities.name: Savaryn
entities.description: A companion of Terrik, Ambrellin and Bazda in the catacombs.

entities.name: Orzhov pontiff
entities.description: A desperate Orzhov pontiff who runs an underground operation minting gold from copper and later fuses with his thrull.

entities.name: Orzhov basilica
entities.description: A ruined basilica beneath which Terrik's group explores catacombs.

entities.name: Izzet technology
entities.description: Ancient Izzet machine used by the pontiff to mint gold coins from copper, missing a piece Bazda had stashed.

events.summary: Bazda discovers Terrik's identity as the secret supporter of her orphanage and confronts him.
events.quote: Bazda discovered his identity and confronted him

events.summary: Ambrellin challenges Terrik about his unresolved grief and obsession with atonement.
events.quote: also challenged him about his unresolved grief and obsession with atoning for his past mistakes.

events.summary: Terrik proposes exploring beneath the ruined Orzhov basilica, and the group finds a catacomb with relics and dangers, including their wurm's betrayal.
events.quote: Terrik proposed a daring adventure to explore beneath the ruined Orzhov basilica

events.summary: A collapse traps the group in a subterranean corridor; tensions flare and they discover the pontiff's illegal gold-minting operation.
events.quote: found themselves trapped in a subterranean corridor after a collapse.

events.summary: The group is forced into labor; Terrik learns a spirit is Bazda's mother and destroys the pontiff's contract book, temporarily freeing the spirits.
events.quote: Terrik seized an opportunity to disrupt the operation by destroying the pontiff's contract book, temporarily freeing the spirits.

events.summary: Terrik pushes the pontiff into a pit; Ambrellin activates the machine, and Terrik pays off their debts, leaving the fused pontiff powerless.
events.quote: Terrik asserted their freedom by paying off their debts.

events.summary: The group escapes the catacombs on a wurm, reunites with Bazda's parents and offers them a fresh start.
events.quote: They reunited with Bazda's parents and offered them a fresh start.

relations.note: An elven wurmcaller of the Conclave.
relations.quote: Terrik is an elven wurmcaller, part of the Selesnya Conclave on the plane of Ravnica .

relations.note: Friend and host, a dryad who lets him stay in her room.
Terrik pushed the pontiff into a pit and freed his group from him.
relations.quote: Terrik managed to push the pontiff into a pit
